Market Information CVS Health Corporation's common stock is listed on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol “CVS.” Dividends During 2022, 2021 and 2020, the quarterly cash dividend was $0.55, $0.50 and $0.50 per share, respectively. CVS Health Corporation has paid cash dividends every quarter since becoming a public company. Future dividends will depend on the Company's earnings, capital requirements, financial condition and other factors considered relevant by the Board.
